onboardingFlow.title: The fastest path to productivity
onboardingFlow.subtitle: Structure, progress, questions and context in one place. From day-one access to understanding how things work in the company and why they are done that way.

checklist.title: A structured onboarding list
checklist.description: Every step is defined, with an owner, a deadline and all the information that belongs to it. Nobody has to guess what comes next.

progress.title: Progress is tracked
progress.description: Team leads and admins have a complete view of onboarding progress at any time, and see immediately when someone needs support.

questions.title: Questions and feedback
questions.description: New hires can ask questions about individual steps right inside the onboarding flow, or note down what is still unclear. That way onboarding improves with every new team member.
questions.question: Where do I find the macOS VPN profile?
questions.answer: In the self-service portal under Devices. IT approves the request automatically.
questions.feedbackText: The step doesn't say where the profile lives.

course.title: Courses, not a step-by-step manual
course.description: Scibly explains not just what to do but why. New hires understand the company's tools and decisions instead of working through a checklist blind.
course.lessonTitle: Why deals go into the CRM first
course.whyText: Without a CRM entry the forecast is wrong, and the team cannot see which deals are actually live.
course.quizQuestion: A customer says yes on the phone. What first?
course.quizOptionRight: Create the deal in the CRM, then the contract
